Class RemapFilterBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.RemapFilterBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogBuilder<RemapFilterBuilder, LogRouter.Router.Filter>
public final class RemapFilterBuilder extends Object implements LogBuilder<RemapFilterBuilder, LogRouter.Router.Filter>
Builder to create LogRouter.Router.Filter. Moves events from one level to another, for example to make a noisy dependency's warnings info. The route drops an event moved to a level it does not enable for the event's logger.
Properties retrieved from LogProperties
Property Pattern Type Required Default Description
logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.levels List<String> true null from:to level pairs, for example warning:info,error:warning. Levels not listed are kept.
logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.loggers List<String> true none, so every logger Logger names whose events are moved, including their children.
